provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Besleaga, from the reporting subject's own published sustainability page and its 2020 data-centre emissions methodology post; NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject. Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: DATA-CENTRE OPERATIONS ONLY, and 2020-vintage: this is the most recent figure Automattic publishes, six years old at the time of mapping. carbon-accounting is omitted because the source never states a basis. The source classifies these emissions as Scope 3 ("we treat the emissions from data center power use as being in Scope 3"), so scope-3 carries the same figure; Scope 1 and 2 are not published and are omitted. The reporting-period and updated members exist precisely so a consumer can see this staleness.
